newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Atlantik co-founder Hobbs found dead.
newsitem.headline: Czech Atlantik co-founder Hobbs found dead.

text.p: Michael Hobbs, the U.S.-born founding partner of the Czech brokerage firm, Atlantik Financni Trhy s.r.o. was found dead in his central Prague apartment, an Atlantik spokewoman said on Wednesday.
In a statement, Katerina Kotyzova quoted police as saying Hobbs was found dead last Thursday and the cause of death was still unclear. He was 37.
"The police found no signs of violence," she said.
Hobbs, a native of San Diego and graduate of Yale University, came to the former Czechoslovakia in 1991 to teach finance and economics at Masaryk University in the Czech second city of Brno.

There he co-founded Atlantik in 1993 along with his former students Daniel Gladis and Karel Bastl, setting up a thriving business alongside the country's massive post-Communist privatisation programme.

Last summer, Hobbs resigned his executive position in the company after he said his partners had called an extraordinary shareholders' meeting of the limited liability company to strip him of his authority.
Hobbs said at the time that he would still hold on to his one-third share in Atlantik.
